name: OmaRGB
author: Ilkay Dinc
description: RGB lighting from the Omarchy bar, following your theme. Every device OpenRGB sees, with mode, color, brightness and speed; stealth mode; changes made elsewhere mirrored.

barWidget.description: Your RGB hardware on the theme accent, plus per-device mode, color, brightness, speed and power, and a stealth switch. Through OpenRGB.

schema.label: Follow the theme accent
schema.description: Push the active theme's accent color to every device whenever the theme changes.

schema.label: Vivid accent on devices
schema.description: LEDs render muted colors as white, so the accent is pushed with lifted saturation. Turn off to send the exact accent.

schema.label: Start the OpenRGB server when none is running
schema.description: Launches `openrgb --server` once per session if nothing answers on the SDK port.
